_doc: Idle thread and wakeup budget per process kind (scripts/cmux-next/idle-budget.py; plans/cmux-next/idle-wakeups.md section 7). Idle: no input, no visible change, terminals quiet, after the settle. Fields: wakeups_per_s and cpu_pct are the sum over the kind's processes; wakeups_max and threads_max are per process; main_wakes_per_s is the app's main run loop. A value may be one number or {session: number}. null: measured and reported, not judged yet (thread caps are set from the first measurement after the fixes). Proposed by PL-idle 2026-10-24 with the Performance Lead: app main thread 0, app <= 1/s, daemon <= 1/s, holder 0. Chromium's processes (cef-gpu, cef-renderer, cef-utility): each <= 1 wakeup/s, what idle-wakeups.md section 7 measured for every Chromium helper with a static tab after the pump fix ('After' table: each <= 0.023% CPU, < 1 wakeup/s). The perf cron's idle-budget part judges these as idle_budget.<session>.<kind>.<field> rows (perf-cron.py).
